name: AuxPair.theta_eq_smul_star_lift_swap
summary: Evaluate at a point y of the adelic group of W: the conjugate of the lift is an integral over g in [U(I_n)] of an automorphic theta function of g against F_Xi(g) (the conjugation inside the lift cancels against the one applied to its output); the class-integral formula for algebraic forms turns it into (dim)^(-1) times a class integral of conjKernel, which by the level equivariance (H) is the class sum defining theta(Xi).

steps.claim: Evaluate both sides at y and move the complex conjugation inside the integral of Space.lift.

H: for k in the level and g, conjKernel(O, y, g k)(Xi(g k)) = conjKernel(O, y, g)(Xi(g)), from the transformation law of Xi under the level (character levelChar(O)) and conjKernel_equivariant with gamma = 1.
steps.lean: have H k g := levelSpace_smoothFormRep_apply Ξ.2 1 g k ▸ O.conjKernel_equivariant _ _ _ y g

steps.claim: The integral over [U(I_n)] of the automorphic theta function (automorphic since the datum has a level, exists_level_pairWeil) against F_Xi = ofAlgForm(paramV(O), 1, Xi) equals (dim)^(-1) times the class integral of conjKernel(O, y, g)(Xi(g)) (integral_mul_eq_classIntegral, with the transformation of the integrand from pairWeil_fockDatum and the highest vector equal to its conjugate); by H the class integral is the class sum over the level, that is theta(O)(Xi)(y) up to the index stdLevelIndex(levelGroup(O)).
steps.lean:
erw [← star_highestVector, Space.integral_mul_eq_classIntegral O.isHCParam_paramV O.levelGroup
    ((O.pairThetaKernel.swap.isAutomorphic _ (by erw [pairWeil_integrated_fin O.W,
    (exists_level_pairWeil _ _ O.auxDatum.2).choose_spec.choose_spec _ (one_mem _) · ·]) y).conj)
    (O.conjKernel y) (by simpa [← pairTheta_mul]
    using! congr(star <| pairTheta _ _ O.a O.b $(O.pairWeil_fockDatum · 1 _) ⟨_, 1, ·⟩)),
    classIntegral_eq_classSum (by simpa using! H)]; simp [field, θ, -Fintype.card_pi]
